question: Which singer and music director was awarded the Padma Vibhushan posthumously in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SP Balasubhrahmanyam.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sripathi Panditaradhyula Balasubrahmanyam** (4 June 1946 – 25 September 2020), was awarded the Padma Vibhushan posthumously in 2021.
 
• He was also known as SPB or Balu, was an Indian playback singer, and television presenter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Sudarshan Sahoo (born 11 March 1939) is an Indian sculpture artist from Puri in Odisha.[He was awarded India's second highest civilian award Padma Vibhushan in 2021 and India's fourth highest civilian award Padma Shri in 1988. Sahoo established Sudarshan Crafts Museum, Puri in 1977, and Sudarshan Art & Crafts Village, Bhubaneswar in 1991 with the help of the Government of Odisha.

 
• SVARAM brings together the rich tradition of Indian Music and Craft and international academic musicology, sound studies and research, and contemporary design.
